Tomato___Early_blight.cause: Fungus Alternaria solani thrives in warm, humid conditions, spreads via spores on debris.
Tomato___Early_blight.solution: 1. Remove and burn infected leaves. 2. Apply fungicide (Mancozeb or Chlorothalonil) weekly. 3. Improve air circulation. 4. Use disease-free seeds. 5. Mulch soil.

Tomato___Late_blight.cause: Phytophthora infestans fungus, cool moist weather favors spread.
Tomato___Late_blight.solution: 1. Apply copper-based fungicide immediately. 2. Water at base, avoid leaves. 3. Space plants for airflow. 4. Destroy infected plants. 5. Choose resistant varieties.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.cause: Xanthomonas bacteria, via rain splash from soil or seeds.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.solution: 1. Use copper bactericide. 2. Avoid overhead watering. 3. Rotate crops 2-3 years. 4. Remove volunteers. 5. Hot water treat seeds.

Potato___Early_blight.cause: Alternaria solani, survives on infected debris.
Potato___Early_blight.solution: 1. Fungicide sprays (Dithane). 2. Hill soil around plants. 3. Remove lower leaves. 4. Crop rotation. 5. Certified seed tubers.

Potato___Late_blight.cause: Phytophthora infestans, wet foliage key factor.
Potato___Late_blight.solution: 1. Preventive fungicide (Ridomil). 2. No irrigation during humid periods. 3. Destroy cull piles. 4. Resistant varieties like Kufri Jyoti.

Apple___Apple_scab.solution: 1. Fungicide during bud swell (Captan). 2. Rake leaves in fall. 3. Prune for airflow. 4. Resistant varieties.

Apple___Black_rot.solution: 1. Prune cankers. 2. Fungicide. 3. Avoid mower injury.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust.solution: 1. Resistant hybrids. 2. Fungicide if severe. 3. Crop rotation.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.solution: 1. Copper sprays. 2. Fixed copper weekly. 3. Plastic mulch.
